{"basis": "literature", "gene": "RAET1G", "note": "RAET1G1 encodes transmembrane and cytoplasmic domains \"unique amongst NKG2D ligands\" and RAET1G2 is secreted (Eagle 2009); neither is anchored. {"form": "P19256-2", "gene": "CD58", "note": "Both anchored candidates predict the same omega site (208, S) and are identical through it, so they yield the same mature protein and differ only in the cleaved GPI signal. The reviewed UniProt isoform is the better record, so it is named here rather than by tuning the global ranking around one gene."}
